transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'm Morgan, the casting director. As we get started, I want to make sure we're all on the same page about where things stand. We have two principal roles to fill for this pilot — Mara Vale and Jules Arden — and our finalists are Priya Shah, Tomas Reed, and Lena Brooks. The production has reserved either August 14 or August 15 for a three-hour cast table read. Before I can make the binding casting call, I need both the casting associate to log the chemistry result and the talent coordinator to log the selected actors' availability hold in the final-review checklist. I'll complete the call only once both of those entries are recorded. So let's hear what everyone's got — what do we know about chemistry reads and availability?
